text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the Hanshin Daishoten also concluding 
without incident, just as everyone was 
heading back—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, Orfevre dashed off! ...It seems 
she hasn't had enough running yet. 
However—

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff
text_block_list.text:
"Eeeeeh...!! H-Hold on! What about my 
plans after this...?!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, Orfevre ran away the 
moment I approached... I scrambled to 
chase after her, but naturally, there was 
no catching up—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...What are those two doing? A game of 
tag?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
...It's turned into something like that. 
Trainer looks like they're having a really 
tough time, but—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre looks like... she might be having 
fun... maybe?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look. She stopped again... Ah, she 
started running. ...Ah, she stopped again.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
...A-Are you teasing me? What an... 
amazing duo—
